blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Long-tailed 3D object detection is treated as a class-frequency problem, but LiDAR supervision quality depends on object observability: similar frequencies can hide different geometric evidence. We introduce Geometry-Augmented Exponentially Weighted Instance-Aware Repeat Factor Sampling (GA-EIRFS), a detector-agnostic method that modulates a frequency-based repeat factor with a fixed geometry score combining point count, surface-normal entropy, and surface coverage. GA-EIRFS changes only frame-sampling probabilities, leaving the detector and inference unchanged. On nuScenes it improves mean average precision (mAP) and the nuScenes detection score (NDS) in four converged experiments with CenterPoint and PointPillars over two seeds; for CenterPoint at seed 666, mAP rises from 0.552 to 0.563 and bicycle AP from 0.306 to 0.359. Per-class gains correlate with the class sampling-weight increase (Spearman ρ = 0.70 \rho=0.70 , p = 0.025 p=0.025 ) but not with geometry score alone ( ρ = 0.32 \rho=0.32 , p = 0.37 p=0.37 ), so geometry amplifies frequency-driven need. KITTI results vary across seeds, most for the rarest class. Code: https://github.com/Multimodal-Sensing-Lab/GA-EIRFS .
blocks.zh: 长尾的3D物体探测被作为类频问题处理,但LiDAR监督质量取决于物体可观察性:类似的频率可以隐藏不同的几何证据. 我们引入了几何-增量指数-智能重复因子取样法(GA-EIRFS),这是一种探测器-不可知论方法,它用固定的几何分数来调制频率重复因子,结合点数,表面正常的演算,表面覆盖. GA-EIRFS只改变帧抽样概率,使探测器和推论保持不变. 在NuScenes上,在与CenterPoint和PointPillars在两个种子上进行的四个集中实验中,它提高了平均精度(mAP)和nuScenes检测分数(NDS);对于CenterPoint在666种子上,mAP从0.552上升到0.563,自行车AP从0.306上升到0.359。 每类增益与类采样-重量增益相关(Spearman $ 0.70\rho = 0.70,p = 0.025 p = 0.025),但不单与几何分数相关(ρ = 0.32\rho = 0.32,p = 0.37 p = 0.37),因此几何可以放大频率驱动的需要. KITTI的结果因种子而异,大多数是属于最稀有的种类. 代码:https://github.com/多式联运-传感器-Lab/GA-EIRFS 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: LiDAR-based 3D object detection supports autonomous vehicles, mobile robots, inspection drones and roadside sensing, where missing an uncommon but safety-relevant object can have serious consequences . Annotated datasets often contain far fewer examples of such objects than of common categories. For example, in the nuScenes database training split [ 2 ] , annotated cars outnumber bicycles by 41.5:1, which presents a challenge in learning to detect underrepresented classes [ 18 , 11 ] . We evaluate on driving benchmarks, but the underlying problem of imbalanced training data extends to other LiDAR applications .
blocks.zh: 基于LiDAR的3D物体探测支持自主车辆,移动机器人,检查无人机和路边感知,其中缺失一个不寻常但与安全相关的物体可能会产生严重后果. 附加说明的数据集中这类对象的示例往往远少于常见的类别. 例如,在nuScens数据库培训中,附加说明的汽车数量比自行车多41.5:1,这给学习检测代表性不足的班级带来了挑战[18,11]. 我们评价驱动基准,

blocks.en: Sampling-based rebalancing addresses the imbalance without modifying the detector. Repeat Factor Sampling (RFS) [ 6 ] repeats an image according to the frequency of the rarest category it contains. Instance-Aware RFS (IRFS) [ 21 ] combines image and instance frequency through a geometric mean, and E-IRFS [ 1 ] applies an exponential function to that mean so that extremely rare categories receive a stronger adjustment. In 3D detection, Class-Balanced Grouping and Sampling (CBGS) duplicates frames by category occurrence [ 24 ] . Every method in this family reads annotation counts only.
blocks.zh: 基于抽样的再平衡在不修改探测器的情况下解决不平衡问题。 重复因子采样(RFS)[6]根据它包含的最稀有类别的频率重复一个图像. E-IRFS [21]通过几何平均值将图像和实例频率结合起来,E-IRFS [1] 将指数函数应用于该平均值,这样极罕见的类别得到更强的调整. 在3D检测中,Class-Balanced Grouping和抽样(CBGS)按发生类别重复帧[24]. 这个家庭的每一种方法 都只读注释

blocks.en: Frequency is not the same as observability. LiDAR returns depend on object size, range, orientation, occlusion and surface structure. In the nuScenes training split a bicycle box contains 16.9 points on average, against 98.1 for a car and 240.3 for a trailer. Bicycle and trailer are both minority classes and a frequency-based rule gives them similar sampling weight , yet the evidence available per instance differs by more than an order of magnitude. Across the ten classes the frequency term and the geometry score are close to uncorrelated (Spearman ρ = 0.16 \rho=0.16 , p = 0.65 p=0.65 ), as Figure 1 shows, so a rule defined on counts alone cannot separate a rare class that is easy to observe from one that is not.
blocks.zh: 频率与可观察性不同. LiDAR返回取决于对象大小,范围,方向,隐蔽和表面结构. 在nuScenes训练中,一个自行车箱平均包含16.9分,而汽车为98.1分,拖车为240.3分. 自行车和拖车都是少数群体类别,而且基于频率的规则给予它们类似的采样权重,然而,每个实例可用的证据不同,其数量顺序不尽相同。 如图1所示,在十类中,频率术语和几何分数接近于不相关(Spearman à = 0.16\rho = 0.16,p = 0.65 p = 0.65),因此单计值定义的规则不能将一个容易观察的稀有类与非稀有类分开.

Markers are classes, placed by the E-IRFS frequency term q c q_{c} and the geometry score G c G_{c} of Eq. ( 5 ). Grey curves are contours of r c r_{c} ( α = 2.0 \alpha=2.0 , β = 1.0 \beta=1.0 ): vertical distance at fixed rarity is the sampling weight that geometry adds.

blocks.en: We propose Geometry-Augmented E-IRFS (GA-EIRFS), which estimates a fixed class-level geometry score from the annotated LiDAR points before training and uses it to modulate the exponent of the E-IRFS repeat factor. Geometry amplifies an existing frequency-driven adjustment rather than acting on its own, and one parameter controls how much it contributes. The contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们提出几何增强型E-IRFS(GA-EIRFS),在训练前从附加说明的LiDAR分数中估算一个固定的班级几何分数,并用它来调制E-IRFS重复因子的表征. 几何可以放大现有的频率驱动调整,而不是自行行动,一个参数可以控制其贡献多少. 捐款情况如下:

blocks.en: • A geometry-augmented repeat factor that combines class frequency with class-level LiDAR observability and reduces exactly to E-IRFS when the geometry term is disabled. • A geometry score built from three measurable properties of the annotated point sets, computed once before training, with no change to the detector, the loss or the inference path. • An evaluation on nuScenes with two detectors and two seeds, a sweep of the geometry strength, an analysis of which classes benefit and why, and a transfer experiment on KITTI in which the gains are not consistent.
blocks.zh: • 支助 一个几何增殖的重复因子,将类频率与类级的LiDAR可观测性结合起来,并在几何学术语被禁用时精确减小到E-IRFS. • 支助 从附加说明的点集的三个可测量属性中得出的几何分数,在训练前计算一次,没有改变探测器、损失或推论路径。 以两个探测器和两个种子对nuScens进行评价,扫射几何强度,分析哪些类受益及原因,以及对KITTI进行转让实验,其中收益不一致.

blocks.en: A geometry-augmented repeat factor that combines class frequency with class-level LiDAR observability and reduces exactly to E-IRFS when the geometry term is disabled.
blocks.zh: 一个几何增殖的重复因子,将类频率与类级的LiDAR可观测性结合起来,并在几何学术语被禁用时精确减小到E-IRFS.

blocks.en: A geometry score built from three measurable properties of the annotated point sets, computed once before training, with no change to the detector, the loss or the inference path.
blocks.zh: 由附加说明的点数组的三个可测量属性构成的几何分数,在训练前计算一次,对探测器、损失或推论路径没有变化。

blocks.en: An evaluation on nuScenes with two detectors and two seeds, a sweep of the geometry strength, an analysis of which classes benefit and why, and a transfer experiment on KITTI in which the gains are not consistent.
blocks.zh: 以两个探测器和两个种子对nuScens进行评价,扫射几何强度,分析哪些类受益及原因,以及对KITTI进行转让实验,其中收益不一致.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Rebalancing for long-tailed 3D detection. Long-tail mitigation for point clouds acts on the data distribution, on the training objective, or on the detector. CBGS builds a more balanced training distribution and groups related categories [ 24 ] , Lee and Kim combine category-specific heads, dynamic loss averaging and contextual ground-truth sampling [ 9 ] , and Peri et al. formalize long-tailed 3D detection with hierarchical supervision and evaluation [ 18 ] . Later work adds multimodal fusion [ 16 ] , neighbour-based confidence adjustment [ 11 ] , loss reweighting [ 3 ] or few-shot adaptation [ 13 ] . These methods change the objective, the architecture or the modalities , and none of them changes which frames the sampler draws . Frequency and difficulty have been separated before, but outside 3D geometry: CDB-S resamples classes by measured validation difficulty [ 19 ] and geometric priors have shaped the feature space in long-tailed classification [ 15 ] . Both derive difficulty from model behaviour rather than from the sensor evidence.
blocks.zh: 重新平衡用于长尾3D检测. 点云的长尾缓解作用于数据分布,训练目标,或探测器. CBGS构建了更加均衡的培训分布和群体相关类别[24],李和金组合了特定类别的头,动态损失平均和背景的地面真实取样[9],Peri等人将长尾3D检测正规化,并进行分级监督和评价[18]. 后来的工作增加了多式聚变[16],基于邻居的置信调整[11],减重重[3]或几发改编[13]. 这些方法改变了目标、架构或模式,没有改变取样人绘制的框。 频率和难度此前已分离,但3D几何之外: CDB-S通过测量验证难度的复标分类[19]和几何前缀在长尾分类中塑造了特征空间[15]. 两者都从模型行为而不是传感器证据中获得困难.

blocks.en: Geometry and difficulty-aware training. Point density has been used to guide internal point selection and attention in DA-3DSSD [ 17 ] and in density-aware set abstraction [ 23 ] . PointDrop generates sparse adversarial examples [ 14 ] , and density-adaptive augmentation modifies point-cloud content [ 10 ] . All of these act inside the detector or inside a scene. The closest operational method is Curricular Object Manipulation (COM) [ 25 ] , which groups database objects by distance, dimensions, orientation and occupancy, then progressively selects harder objects for ground-truth copy-paste augmentation. Its sampling unit is an object pasted into a scene and its difficulty is updated from model scores during training. Rare Example Mining [ 7 ] also separates rareness from difficulty, but it selects unlabelled tracks for annotation rather than rebalancing a labelled set, as do active-annotation methods [ 4 , 12 ] .
blocks.zh: 几何与难度认识训练. 点密度在DA-3DSD[17]和密度感知集抽象[23]中被用于指导内部点选择和注意. PointDrop生成稀少的对抗性实例[14],密度适应性增强改变点-云内容[10]. 所有这些行为都发生在探测器内部或场景内部. 最近的操作方法是Booker Object Manipulation(COM)[25],该方法按距离,尺寸,方向和占用情况对数据库对象进行分组,然后逐步选择更硬的物体进行地面真实的复制-粘贴增强. 其采样单位是粘贴在场景中的物体,其难度在训练期间从模型分数中更新. " 稀有实例采矿 " [7] 还将稀有性与难性区分开来,但它选择了无标签的音轨进行注释,而不是重新平衡一个标签集,主动注释方法[4,12]也是如此.

blocks.en: Gap and positioning. Two gaps follow. The sampling methods decide how often a frame is drawn from annotation counts alone, so they cannot separate a rare class the sensor observes well from one it observes poorly. The geometry-aware methods do read sensor structure, but they act inside the detector or inside a synthesised scene, and those that separate rarity from difficulty estimate difficulty from model behaviour or select data for annotation. We found no method that inserts a fixed, sensor-derived geometry score directly into a frame repeat factor. GA-EIRFS targets that gap: it scores class-level observability once from the annotated points and multiplies it into the exponent of an existing frequency-based repeat factor, leaving the detector, the loss and inference untouched. Section 3 defines the two priors and how they combine.
blocks.zh: 差距和定位。 后结二障. 取样方法决定一个框架如何经常单独从注释中抽取,因此它们不能将传感器观察到的罕见类别与其观察到的不良类别分开。 几何感知方法确实读取了感知结构,但它们在探测器内或合成场景内作用,以及那些从模型行为中将难度与难度估计难度区分开来或选择数据进行注释的方法. 我们发现没有方法将固定的,传感器衍生的几何分数直接插入帧重复因子. GA-EIRFS针对的是这个缺口:它从注释点评一次级可观察性,并将它乘以现有的频率重复因子的指数,使探测器,损失和推论不受影响. 第3节界定了两个前科及其合并方式。

blocks.zh: 3.1 前频

Following E-IRFS [ 1 ] , the frequency term is given by: q c = t f i , c ​ f b , c , q_{c}=\sqrt{\frac{t}{\sqrt{f_{i,c}\,f_{b,c}}}}, (1) where t t sets the threshold at which oversampling becomes active. The term grows as either frequency falls and treats classes with comparable occurrence statistics identically.

blocks.en: 3.2 Class-level geometry prior
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 前一级几何

blocks.en: For every annotated instance, we collect the LiDAR points inside its ground-truth 3D box. Let 𝒩 ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \mathcal{N}(\cdot) denote min-max normalization across the classes of the dataset. Each component is constructed to lie in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , with higher values indicating a greater estimated geometric difficulty. The first component penalizes low point support and is defined as: D c = 1 − 𝒩 ⁡ ( log ⁡ ( 1 + n ¯ c ) ) , D_{c}=1-\mathcal{N}\!\left(\log(1+\bar{n}_{c})\right), (2) where n ¯ c \bar{n}_{c} is the mean number of in-box points per instance of class c c . The logarithm reduces the influence of classes with very high point counts on the normalization. In nuScenes, the traffic cone class has D c = 1.00 D_{c}=1.00 , with 9.2 points per instance on average, while the bus class has D c = 0.00 D_{c}=0.00 , with 312.4 points per instance.

The second component measures surface diversity through the distribution of local surface-normal orientations. Normals are estimated for each instance and assigned to 256 orientation bins. The normalized class-level entropy is defined as: H c = 𝒩 ( − ∑ k = 1 256 p c , k log p c , k ) , H_{c}=\mathcal{N}\!\left(-\sum_{k=1}^{256}p_{c,k}\log p_{c,k}\right), (3) where p c , k p_{c,k} is the probability assigned to orientation bin k k for class c c . A flat panel exhibits similar normal orientations and low entropy, whereas an irregular structure such as a bicycle frame can exhibit more diverse orientations and higher entropy. Instances with fewer than ten points are excluded from the entropy calculation because their normal estimates are unstable. Assigning zero entropy to these instances would artificially lower the estimated surface diversity of sparsely sampled classes.

blocks.en: The product form in Eq. ( 6 ) is deliberate. Geometry scales a weight that rarity has already requested, so a common class that happens to be geometrically difficult is not promoted on its own. Table 1 reports the effect. Bicycle and trailer receive similar sampling weight under E-IRFS, at 2.58 and 2.06, a ratio of 1.25. Under GA-EIRFS the factors become 5.61 and 2.63 and the ratio widens to 2.14, while car moves only from 1.29 to 1.49. Taking the maximum over the classes in a frame, rather than a product, avoids compounding when several minority classes co-occur and preserves the frame-level behaviour of E-IRFS, so that β \beta isolates geometry. The cost is one offline pass over the annotated in-box points.
blocks.zh: Eq.(6)中的产品形式是故意的。 几何尺度的重量是稀有的,已经要求过,所以一个偶然的几何难度的普通类并不靠自己来推广. 表1报告了效果。 自行车和拖车在E-IRFS下获得类似的取样重量,为2.58和2.06,比例为1.25. 在GA-EIRFS下,因数变为5.61和2.63,比率扩大至2.14,而汽车只行驶1.29至1.49。 在一个框架而不是一个产品中取得最大分数,避免了几个少数阶层共同混入时的复合,并保持了E-IRFS的帧级行为,从而β\β分离几何. 费用是连线通过注解的收件点。

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: Datasets. The main evaluation uses nuScenes [ 2 ] , comprised of 1000 driving scenes recorded with a 32-beam LiDAR at 20 Hz. We use the standard split of 700 training and 150 validation scenes, that is 28,130 and 6,019 annotated keyframes, and the ten official detection classes. Transfer is assessed on KITTI [ 5 ] , which uses a 64-beam sensor, single sweeps and three classes, and whose Car to Cyclist ratio of about 19.6 to 1 is milder than the 41.5 to 1 ratio on nuScenes.
blocks.zh: 数据集. 主评价使用nuScens [2],由1000个驾驶场组成,记录在20Hz的LiDAR的32波束. 我们使用700个培训和150个验证场景的标准分成,即28,130个和6,019个附加说明的键框,以及10个正式检测班。 转让按KITTI[5]进行评估,采用64波束传感器,单扫和3个等级,其汽车与自行车列表的比率约为19.6比1,比nuScenes上的41.5比1要温和.

blocks.en: Models, protocol and metrics. We evaluate CenterPoint [ 22 ] and PointPillars [ 8 ] in OpenPCDet [ 20 ] . The principal nuScenes runs use 20 epochs and the seeds 666 and 1337, that is two repetitions per detector and four paired baseline-to-GA-EIRFS comparisons in total . We set α = 2.0 \alpha=2.0 , t = 0.01 t=0.01 , β = 1.0 \beta=1.0 and ( λ D , λ H , λ S ) = ( 0.5 , 0.3 , 0.2 ) (\lambda_{D},\lambda_{H},\lambda_{S})=(0.5,0.3,0.2) , weighting density most because it is measured directly rather than estimated. The geometry sweep uses 12 epochs and β ∈ { 0 , 0.5 , 1.0 , 2.0 } \beta\in\{0,0.5,1.0,2.0\} . For KITTI we keep α \alpha , t t and β \beta unchanged, recompute G c G_{c} from the KITTI point clouds, use PointPillars with the reference OpenPCDet configuration and no road-plane augmentation, and evaluate the seeds 666, 1337 and 42 ( 3 repetitions ). We report nuScenes mean average precision (mAP) and the nuScenes detection score (NDS) : mAP matches predictions to ground truth by center distance, while NDS combines mAP with the true-positive errors in translation, scale, orientation, velocity and attribute [ 2 ] ; per-class AP; and KITTI moderate-difficulty 3D AP via box IoU [ 5 ] . Every comparison is paired: baseline and GA-EIRFS share detector, schedule, augmentation and seed, and differ only in the sampler.
blocks.zh: 模式、协议和衡量标准。 在OpenPCDet [20] 评测中心点 [22] 和点数盘 [8] 。 主nuScens使用20个纪元,种子666和1337,即每个探测器重复两次,总共进行4对基准对GA-EIRFS比较。 我们设定 α = 2.0\ alpha = 2.0, t = 0.01 t = 0.01, β = 1.0\ beta = 1.0和 (λ D, λ H, λ S) = (0.5, 0.3, 0.2) (\lambda_{ D},\lambda_{H},\lambda_{S}) = (0.5, 0.3, 0.2), 加权密度最多是因为它是直接测量而不是估计的. 几何扫描使用12个纪元和β {{0, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0}\β\in}0, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0}. 对于 KITTI, 我们保留α\ alpha, t和β\β\beta不变, 从 KITTI 点云重算 G c G\\c}, 使用 PointPillars 与参考 OpenPCDet 配置 和 没有 road-plane 增强, 并评估 种子 666, 1337 和 42 ( 3 重复 ) 。 我们报告nuScenes指平均精度(mAP)和nuScenes检测分数(NDS): mAP按中心距离匹配预测与地面真理,而NDS将mAP与翻译,尺度,定向,速度和属性的真阳性错误结合在一起[2];每类AP;以及KITTI中度困难3DAP通过盒IoU[5]. 每次比较都是对齐的:基线和GA-EIRFS共享探测器,调度,增强和种子,并且只在采样器中有所不同.

blocks.en: 5 Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 5. 结果和讨论

blocks.en: Overall performance. Table 2 reports the four fully converged nuScenes comparisons. GA-EIRFS increases both mAP and NDS in every run, by 0.4 to 1.3 pp mAP and 0.3 to 0.7 pp NDS. Over the four paired runs the mean gain is + 0.91 +0.91 pp mAP (95% confidence interval [ 0.27 , 1.55 ] [0.27,1.55] , paired t t test p = 0.020 p=0.020 ) and + 0.49 +0.49 pp NDS ( [ 0.12 , 0.86 ] [0.12,0.86] , p = 0.025 p=0.025 ). Both intervals exclude zero, although four observations pooled over two architectures bound the effect rather than fix it. The two detectors differ in backbone, feature representation and detection head, so the agreement indicates that the effect is not tied to one architecture. The 12-epoch runs isolate the geometry term from the exponential frequency weighting. E-IRFS reproduces the vanilla mAP exactly under both seeds, 0.5303 and 0.5361, while adding geometry raises it to 0.5398 and 0.5428, so the improvement is attributable to G c G_{c} and not to the reweighting it modulates.
blocks.zh: 总体表现. 表2报告了四个完全趋同的nuScens比较。 GA-EIRFS每次运行都会增加mAP和NDS,增加0.4至1.3ppmAP和0.3至0.7ppNDS. 在四个对齐的运行中,平均增益为+ 0.91 + 0.91 pp mAP(95%的置信间隔 [0.27, 1.55] [0.27, 1.55] ),对齐 t t测试p = 0.020 p = 0.020 p + 0.49 pp NDS ([0.12, 0.86] [0.12, 0.86], p = 0.025 p 0.025) 两种间隔都排除了零,虽然在两个架构上集合了四个观察,约束效果而不是固定效果. 两种探测器在骨干,特征表现和探测头上有所不同,因此协议表明效果没有与一个架构挂钩. 12世纪运行将几何学术语与指数频率加权隔离. E-IRFS完全在两种种子下繁殖香草mAP,0.5303和0.5361,同时加入几何将其提升到0.5398和0.5428,因此改进归因于Gc G_{c}而不是它的调制重量.

The last row is the mean of the four paired differences, with 95% confidence intervals [ + 0.27 , + 1.55 ] [+0.27,+1.55] for mAP and [ + 0.12 , + 0.86 ] [+0.12,+0.86] for NDS.

blocks.en: Which classes benefit. We divide the ten classes of Table 1 into the 5 rarest and the 5 most frequent. For CenterPoint at seed 666 the mean AP of the rare group rises from 0.393 to 0.410, a gain of 1.7 pp, whereas the frequent group moves from 0.712 to 0.716. Bicycle improves from 0.306 to 0.359, a gain of 5.3 pp or 17%. Figure 3 (a) shows how consistently these effects repeat. Across the four runs, overall mAP and NDS improve in four of four, as do bicycle and motorcycle, while barrier, traffic cone, bus, truck and construction vehicle improve in three of four. Trailer splits two against two, so its behaviour is better described as run-to-run variation than as a systematic loss. Car and pedestrian, which already saturate, never degrade.
blocks.zh: 哪个班才有好处 我们把表1的十类分为最罕见的五类和最频繁的五类. 对于CenterPoint at scent 666,稀有组的平均AP从0.393上升到0.410,增益1.7pp,而频繁组从0.712上升到0.716. 自行车从0.306升至0.359,增益5.3pp或17%. 图3(a)显示这些效应是否一致地重复。 在四条线路中,总体mAP和NDS在四条线路中都有改善,自行车和摩托车也有改善,而屏障、交通锥、公共汽车、卡车和建筑车辆在四条线路中的三条线路中也有改善。 拖车将2对2拆分,因此其行为被更好地描述为跑到跑的变异,而不是系统性的损失. 已经饱和的汽车和行人,永远不会退化.

blocks.en: Why they benefit. The geometry score alone does not predict the per-class outcome. Over the ten classes the rank correlation between G c G_{c} and AP change is weak ( ρ = 0.32 \rho=0.32 , p = 0.37 p=0.37 ), whereas the gain in the class sampling weight Δ ​ r c = r c ​ ( β = 1 ) − r c ​ ( β = 0 ) \Delta r_{c}=r_{c}(\beta{=}1)-r_{c}(\beta{=}0) correlates considerably better ( ρ = 0.70 \rho=0.70 , p = 0.025 p=0.025 ), as plotted in Figure 3 (c). This quantity measures a change in class sampling weight, not observed training exposure: frame weights are determined by the maximum class weight and normalized across all training frames, so actual class exposure also depends on co-occurrence. This supports the mechanism the product form was designed for: geometry is useful when it amplifies a frequency-driven need for exposure and has little effect when the frequency term is already small. The sweep in Figure 3 (b) gives the most direct evidence that G c G_{c} drives the effect: bicycle AP rises monotonically from 0.283 at β = 0 \beta=0 to 0.354 at β = 2 \beta=2 , motorcycle AP follows the same ordering, and overall mAP stays within 0.34 pp for every nonzero β \beta . A range-corrected G c G_{c} preserves the class ranking ( ρ = 0.939 \rho=0.939 ), so the score is not merely a proxy for the distance distribution of a class. With ten class observations, these p p -values are diagnostic rather than confirmatory.
blocks.zh: 为什么他们受益。 仅几何分数并不能预测每类结果. 在这10个类别中,Gc GQQc}与AP变化之间的等级关系很弱(ρ=0.32\rho=0.32,p=0.37 p=0.37),而类抽样重量的增益 r c=r c (β=1) - r c (β = 0) ; \Delta r_{c}=r_{c}(\beta{=}1)-r_{c}(\beta{=}0)关系要好得多(ρ=0.70\rho=0.70,p=0.025p=0.025),如图3(c)所示。 这一数量衡量班级采样重量的变化,没有观测到的训练接触:帧重量由最高班级重量决定,并对所有训练框架实现常态化,因此实际班级接触也取决于是否同时发生。 这支持了产品形式所设计的机理:当它放大了频率驱动的曝光需求时,几何是有用的,当频率术语已经很小时,其效果也很小. 图3(b)中的扫码给出了最直接的证据表明Gc GQQc}驱动效果:自行车AP单调从β=0\β=0上升至β=2\β=2的0.354,摩托车AP遵循相同的订单,对于每个非零β\β=β=0.34pp范围内的总的mAP. 一个范围修正的Gc GQQc}保留了班级排名(^ 0.939\rho=0.939),因此分数不仅仅是一个班级的距离分布的代名词. 有了十个类的观测结果,这些p -值是诊断性的,而不是确认性的.

blocks.en: Qualitative behaviour. Figure 4 shows a validation frame with two bicycles at different ranges. Neither vanilla training nor E-IRFS produces a bicycle prediction above the operating threshold, while GA-EIRFS recovers both. The frame was selected as a case in which the frequency-only sampler and the baseline behave identically, the condition the geometry term is meant to change. One frame is not evidence of the size of the effect.
blocks.zh: 定性行为. 图4显示的是两辆自行车在不同范围内的验证框架. 香草培训或E-IRFS都没有产生超过操作阈值的自行车预测,而GA-EIRFS则恢复了两者. 框被选为仅限频率采样器与基线行为相同,几何学术语意在改变的条件. 一个框架不是效果大小的证据.

blocks.en: Transfer to KITTI. On KITTI, Cyclist is the rarest class and, independently, has the highest geometry score at G c = 0.935 G_{c}=0.935 , giving it the largest repeat factor at 4.05 against 1.92 for Pedestrian and 1.38 for Car, so the pattern that motivates the method on nuScenes reappears under a different sensor. The detection results do not follow as cleanly. Table 3 shows that both minority classes lean positive, but neither improvement holds across the three seeds. Pedestrian gains 0.69 pp on average, while Cyclist loses 0.16 pp because the seed 1337 drop outweighs its two gains, and Car is unchanged. We treat KITTI as a boundary condition rather than a generalisation result. A likely contributor is pool size: Cyclist has 734 instances in 514 frames, the smallest pool in either dataset, so its large repeat factor concentrates exposure on few frames, the same mechanism behind trailer’s run-to-run variation on nuScenes.
blocks.zh: 转会到KITTI. 在KITTI上,Cyclist是最罕见的类,独立时以G c = 0.935 G_{c}=0.935的几何分数得分最高,使其在4.05比1.92比1.92比1比38比1比38比1比38比1比3.5比1比1比3.5比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比 检测结果没有那么干净。 表3显示,两个少数民族阶层都呈正向倾斜,但三个种子的改善都不相同。 行人平均收获0.69pp,而Cyclist则损失0.16pp,因为种子1337的下降超过其两项收益,车型不变. 我们把KITTI视为一个边界条件,而不是一个概括的结果。 一个可能的贡献者是集合大小:Cyclist在514帧中有734个实例,是两个数据集中最小的集合,因此其巨大的重复因子将曝光集中在几个帧上,也就是拖车运行到运行变化的nuScenes背后的相同机制。

blocks.en: Limitations. GA-EIRFS uses hand-set mixture weights and one score per class. It cannot represent within-class variation caused by range, weather or occlusion, and repeating a frame also repeats the frequent objects and background it contains, which is the most likely reason why classes such as trailer respond inconsistently. The nuScenes evidence covers two detectors and two seeds, so the associations constrain the mechanism but do not establish it, and the method was not compared directly against curriculum-based augmentation under a shared protocol.
blocks.zh: 限制。 GA-EIRFS采用手定式混合物重量,每班1分. 它不能代表由范围,天气或隔离导致的班内变化,重复一个帧也会重复它包含的频繁对象和背景,这也是拖车等班级反应不一致的最可能原因. nuScens证据包括两个探测器和两个种子,因此协会制约了这个机制,但没有建立这个机制,而且这个方法没有直接与一个共享协议下的基于课程的增强相比.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented GA-EIRFS, a rebalancing method that inserts a fixed class-level LiDAR geometry prior into a frequency-based frame repeat factor. On nuScenes, mAP and NDS increased in all four converged detector and seed combinations, bicycle AP increased by 5.3 pp for CenterPoint at seed 666, and it grew monotonically with β \beta . The gains track the realised sampling-weight change rather than the geometry score itself, which supports reading the method as an amplifier of frequency-driven sampling rather than as an independent difficulty sampler. The evidence is limited to two seeds per detector and to one dataset with a severe imbalance, since the KITTI transfer was not consistent across seeds. Learning the mixture weights and conditioning the score on range or on the instance are the next steps.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了GA-EIRFS,一种再平衡方法,在频率框架重复系数之前插入一个固定的类级的LiDAR几何。 在nuScenes上,mAP和NDS在所有四个交汇的探测器和种子组合中都增加了,对于CenterPoint在666种子上增加了5.3pp的自行车AP,它与β\β单调生长. 收益跟踪已实现的取样加权变化,而不是几何分数本身,后者支持将方法读作频率驱动取样的放大器,而不是独立的难度取样器。 证据仅限于每个探测器两个种子和一个严重不平衡的数据集,因为KITTI在种子之间的传输不一致. 下一步是学习混合重量和在幅度或实例上调节得分。
